posts.title: woman is a tree by the last dinner party
posts.description: having a fun time with the last dinner party lately! i listened to their first album (prelude to ecstasy) a while back and really dug it. sort of waffled on their second album (from the pyre) when it came out late last year. it was one that didn't catch my attention on a first pass-- kind of felt like the vibe, or the sound, or the whatever, was too similar to distinguish from the first album? but
